titleEn: Maximum Number of Words Found in Sentences
title: 句子中的最多单词数
summary: 给定若干由单空格分隔单词的句子，返回任一句子所含单词数的最大值。
insight: 非空句子的单词数等于空格数加一，逐句扫描即可。

solutions.title: 逐句统计空格
solutions.idea: 利用规范输入直接以空格数加一计词。
steps: 每句从 one 开始，遇空格递增

code.java: class Solution { public int mostWordsFound(String[] sentences){int answer=0;for(String sentence:sentences){int words=1;for(int i=0;i<sentence.length();i++)if(sentence.charAt(i)==' ')words++;answer=Math.max(answer,words);}return answer;} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int mostWordsFound(vector<string>& sentences){int answer=0;for(string& sentence:sentences)answer=max(answer,1+(int)count(sentence.begin(),sentence.end(),' '));return answer;} };
